images.caption: Copy of the rune drum belonging to the 100 year old Saami no:Anders Paulsen. Museum of cultural history, Oslo, Norway. The rune drum was confiscated by the authorities of Vadsø in 1691. In 1694 it was transfered to the Royal Art Cabinet in Copenhagen, Since 1979, it has been kept in the saami Museum in Karasjok, county of Finnmark, Norway. Photo May 31, 2007 with a Nikon Coolpix 5600 5,1 Megapixel camera.

In 1694 it was transfered to the Royal Art Cabinet in Copenhagen, Since 1979, it has been kept in the saami Museum in Karasjok, county of Finnmark, Norway.
